justtiers.config.title: Just-Tiers
justtiers.option.enabled.desc: Master switch. When off, nametags render untouched and no lookups are made.
justtiers.option.displayMode.desc: Which leaderboards to show. 'All' shows each site's highest tier side by side.
justtiers.option.showRetired.desc: Retired tiers are shown with an R prefix. When off, a player falls back to their best active tier.
justtiers.option.badgePosition.desc: Whether the tier badge is drawn in front of the player's name or behind it.
justtiers.option.showIcons.desc: The small glyph in front of each tier. With icons off the badge is as short as it gets, and the sites are told apart by tier colour alone.
justtiers.option.showBrackets.desc: The [ ] around the badge. With brackets off the tiers sit against the name with only a space between them.
justtiers.option.gamemode.desc: The gamemode to show for %s. If the player is not ranked in it, their highest tier on that site is shown instead.
justtiers.option.gamemode.inactive: 'all' mode always shows each site's highest tier, so there is no gamemode to pick. Switch mode first.
justtiers.option.gamemode.disabled: Turn Just-Tiers on to change this.
justtiers.option.novaRefresh.desc: NovaTiers has no per-player endpoint, so the full ranked list (~1.7 MB) is downloaded on this interval.
justtiers.option.downloadProgress.desc: Shows a progress bar in the bottom-right corner while the NovaTiers list is downloading. Appears for every download, including the timed refresh.
justtiers.option.refresh.desc: Clears the cache and re-downloads. Use if a site was down.
justtiers.lookup.none: %s is not ranked on any site Just-Tiers could reach.
justtiers.lookup.invalidName: '%s' is not a name a Minecraft account can have.
justtiers.lookup.nameFailed: Could not check who '%s' is — Mojang did not answer.
justtiers.preview.example: Example only — not your real tiers
justtiers.grid.title: %s gamemode
justtiers.grid.hint: Click a gamemode to select it
justtiers.download.title: Downloading NovaTiers
justtiers.command.icons.off: Hiding gamemode icons — sites are told apart by colour
justtiers.option.tierCache.desc: How long a fetched tier is trusted before it is looked up again. Shorter picks up a player who has just been tested, or has just changed tier, sooner; longer means fewer requests. Applies to MCTiers and SubTiers lookups.
justtiers.about.commands: Most settings are also available via /justtiers
justtiers.about.licence: MIT licensed. Tier data belongs to the sites it comes from.
justtiers.option.hideOwnBadge.desc: Leaves your own nametag undecorated. /justtiers lookup and /justtiers scan still show you.
justtiers.option.palette.desc: Which colours tell the three leaderboards apart. Applies to nametags and to every Just-Tiers screen.
justtiers.option.customColor.desc: Only used while the palette is Custom.
justtiers.option.customColor.inactive: Set the palette to Custom to change this.
justtiers.scan.title: Lobby scan
justtiers.scan.empty.noServer: Join a server to scan the players on it.
justtiers.scan.empty.noPlayers: There is nobody here to scan.
